definitionZh: : fullscreen CSS 伪类匹配当前全屏模式中的每个元素. 如果多个元素已被放入全屏模式, 则选择全部元素 。
sourceDefinition: The :fullscreen CSS pseudo-class matches every element that is currently in fullscreen mode. If multiple elements have been put into fullscreen mode, this selects them all.
